arguments.name: containerRecipeArn
arguments.description: (Optional) - Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the container recipe.

arguments.name: distributionConfigurationArn
arguments.description: (Optional) Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Image Builder Distribution Configuration.

arguments.name: enhancedImageMetadataEnabled
arguments.description: (Optional) Whether additional information about the image being created is collected. Defaults to `true`.

arguments.name: executionRole
arguments.description: (Optional) Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the service-linked role to be used by Image Builder to [execute workflows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/manage-image-workflows.html).

arguments.name: imageRecipeArn
arguments.description: (Optional) Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the image recipe.

arguments.name: infrastructureConfigurationArn
arguments.description: (Required) Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Image Builder Infrastructure Configuration.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: (Required) The name of the Workflow parameter.

arguments.name: tags
arguments.description: (Optional) Key-value map of resource tags for the Image Builder Image. If configured with a provider [`defaultTags` configuration block](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#default_tags-configuration-block) present, tags with matching keys will overwrite those defined at the provider-level.

arguments.name: imageScanningEnabled
arguments.description: (Optional) Indicates whether Image Builder keeps a snapshot of the vulnerability scans that Amazon Inspector runs against the build instance when you create a new image. Defaults to `false`.

arguments.name: containerTags
arguments.description: (Optional) Set of tags for Image Builder to apply to the output container image that that Amazon Inspector scans.

arguments.name: repositoryName
arguments.description: (Optional) The name of the container repository that Amazon Inspector scans to identify findings for your container images.

arguments.name: imageTestsEnabled
arguments.description: (Optional) Whether image tests are enabled. Defaults to `true`.

arguments.name: timeoutMinutes
arguments.description: (Optional) Number of minutes before image tests time out. Valid values are between `60` and `1440`. Defaults to `720`.

arguments.name: onFailure
arguments.description: (Optional) The action to take if the workflow fails. Must be one of `CONTINUE` or `ABORT`.

arguments.name: parallelGroup
arguments.description: (Optional) The parallel group in which to run a test Workflow.

arguments.name: workflowArn
arguments.description: (Required) Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Image Builder Workflow.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: (Required) The name of the Workflow parameter.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: (Required) The value of the Workflow parameter.
